question: Whose autobiography is called "half story"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banarasi Das Jain**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Banarsidas was a **poet.** He was originally a **Shrimal Jain merchant.**
 
• He is known for his poetic autobiography **Ardha Kathanak.**
 
• This autobiography is in **Brajbhasha**.
 
• This is the first autobiography written in an Indian language.
 
• He was 55 years old at the time he composed this.
 
• Life in Jain tradition is considered to be 110 years, hence the autobiography was called **Ardha Kathanaka.​ **
